property_summary: In the reference, calling SetLogFile(address) does not permanently lock initialization (intitalized remains unchanged unless Initialized() is called), so calling SetLogFile multiple times by the same or different caller succeeds repeatedly; the mutant sets intitalized = true inside SetLogFile, making the second call revert — the test fuzzes two distinct caller addresses and a log address and asserts that two sequential SetLogFile calls both succeed on the reference but the mutant will cause at least some inputs to make the second call revert.
change_summary: Add assignment to intitalized inside SetLogFile so calling it sets intitalized true and prevents future changes.
